BackupSettings.description: Configuration for local backup creation and lifecycle.

destination.description: Path to backup destination folder (e.g. external volume or dedicated backup root)
destination.title: Destination

keep_generations.description: Minimum number of successful backup generations to preserve
keep_generations.title: Keep Generations

require_remote_export.description: If True, backup fails if remote Salesforce export is missing or incomplete

remote_export_freshness_hours.description: Maximum allowed age of Salesforce candidate export in hours

CapacitySettings.description: Storage capacity thresholds and reserve margins.

reserve_percent.description: Relative reserve percentage of volume capacity (default 10%)
reserve_percent.title: Reserve Percent

warning_multiplier.description: Multiplier of reserve at which capacity warnings are raised
warning_multiplier.title: Warning Multiplier

timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

batch_size.title: Batch Size

raw_payloads_days.description: Age cutoff in days for unreferenced raw payloads
raw_payloads_days.title: Raw Payloads Days

backups_days.description: Age cutoff in days for pruning completed backups
